rights_evidence.finding: The service states that prescribing data is sourced from monthly NHS Business Services Authority files and used under the Open Government Licence.

acquisition_strategy.reason: The public spending views are rolling five-year API windows and the underlying dataset is very large. Each accepted capture must bind endpoint, parameters, explicit date partition, response digest, source commit and retrieval time.

bronze_boundaries: Preserve organisation code/type, BNF code/presentation, month, actual cost, total quantity and total items at source-native grain.
Preserve OpenPrescribing API views separately from upstream NHSBSA monthly EPD files and never claim byte equivalence without comparison evidence.
Do not normalize measures across countries in Bronze.
Do not infer reimbursement eligibility, clinical appropriateness, patient-level use, dispensing or consumption from primary-care prescribing records.
